title: Google\Cloud\Dlp\V2\TableLocation
name: TableLocation
description: Location of a finding within a table.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.row_index
params.description: The zero-based index of the row where the finding is located. Only populated for resources that have a natural ordering, not BigQuery. In BigQuery, to identify the row a finding came from, populate BigQueryOptions.identifying_fields with your primary key column names and when you store the findings the value of those columns will be stored inside of Finding.
